method: function-level microbenchmarks and isolated HTTP A/B runs; all values are per operation unless stated

rounds.change: mtime/size-checked in-memory cache instead of readFile per request
rounds.measure: GET /app.js p50 1.779 → 1.564 ms, p95 2.876 → 2.727 ms; readFile 408 µs vs stat 151 µs

rounds.change: latestMessageId/pinnedMessageId derived from the existing conversation list
rounds.measure: two queries removed, 4.09 µs per poll

rounds.change: one combined mention regex + name map cached per rosterRevision, roster query skipped when no message contains @
rounds.measure: 518.5 → 160.9 µs per 200-message page with 34 agents; roster query (17 µs) and regex build (26 µs) amortized

rounds.change: toAdmin schema check once at startup; broadcast/direct history statements prepared once
rounds.measure: PRAGMA 25.6 µs + prepare 18.4 µs → 1.55 µs reuse per dispatched message

rounds.change: roster and conversation list fetched concurrently
rounds.measure: 1.678 → 1.067 ms per pair of list calls

rounds.change: attachment lookup skipped when the request has no attachmentIds
earliest_available_id cached per (conversationId, messageRevision) across wakes

note: Rounds 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 and 10 are sub-10-µs per operation; they remove avoidable allocations or queries at the request/wake level. The measurable end-to-end items are rounds 1, 4, 6 and 7. All changes preserve response shapes and permissions; rosterRevision and messageRevision invalidation are documented in MAINTENANCE.md.
